title: Add full-screen layout snapshots and scripted parity gate
purpose: Ensure full-screen UI work remains deterministic and does not regress existing scripted automation.
scope: Add golden snapshots for wide layout, narrow fallback, command palette, approval panel and recovery panel.
Add tests that compare full-screen source projections with scripted output expectations.
Add redaction fixtures for command history and preview text.
Add layout tests for long labels and terminal width boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot output is deterministic across repeated local runs.
Full-screen mode and scripted mode share projection sources.
Secret-like content is redacted from layout, history and previews.
failure_modes: Full-screen UI cannot be tested without a live terminal.
Layout snapshots are nondeterministic due to timestamps or cursor state.
